newsitem.title: USA: Reynolds pleased with Q1 profit.
newsitem.headline: Reynolds pleased with Q1 profit.

text.p: Reynolds Metals Co said on Tuesday it was pleased with its first-quarter net income of $43 million, or $0.59 per share, including a gain of $23 million, or $0.32 per share, from the sale of its residential construction products business.

"We are pleased that our first-quarter results show substantial improvement over the $0.13 per share loss we reported in the fourth quarter of 1996, especially when you consider that the first quarter is seasonally our weakest," Chief Executive Jeremiah J. Sheehan said.
"Moving forward, we expect to realize the full benefit of improving aluminum industry fundamentals and seasonal increases in our packaging and consumer products businesses."

The profit in the latest quater compared to 1996 first-quarter net income of $2 million, and a net loss per share of $0.12 after deducting preferred dividends of $9 million. The 1996 first-quarter results were after a charge of $38 million, or $0.60 per share, for the effects of an accounting change and restructuring charges.
Net sales for the 1997 quarter were $1.61 billion, compared to $1.66 billion in the 1996 period.
The company said aluminum shipments totaled 390,000 metric tonnes in the 1997 period, compared to 383,000 tonnes last year.
"First-quarter shipments were relatively flat. Slightly lower net sales, compared to the 1996 first quarter, reflect weaker fabricated products prices," Sheehan said.
"This resulted from the slowdown in economic activity during most of 1996, coupled with reductions of excess inventory by customers," he said.

"Of greater long-range significance is the progress we made toward our performance improvement goal by reducing conversion costs $24 million, compared to the first quarter last year. We realized additional benefits from lower SG&A and interest costs.
"This puts us well on our way to achieving our performance improvement goal of $100 million by year end," said Sheehan.

"Finally, as the result of our Portfolio Review, we expect to significantly improve our operations and the quality of our earnings, as well as strengthen our financial position. We plan to report the detailed results of our Portfolio Review when we announce second quarter results," said Sheehan.
